name: An Absurd Jittery Day
source:
The day is normal, the sky is blue, all is well.

You go through your normal morning routine, but then, tragedy strikes. The world ends, and you go out knowing you didn't have a life worth living. 

Waking up, you're back at the beginning of the day. 

What will you do this time? Jump into this time-twisting, world-impacting game today! 

[From [url=https://portdev.itch.io/aajd]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这一天很正常，天空很蓝，一切都很好。

你经历了正常的早晨例行公事，但随后，悲剧发生了。世界末日，你走出去，知道自己没有值得过的生活。

一觉醒来，你又回到了一天的开始。

这次你会做什么？今天就加入这个扭曲时间、影响世界的游戏吧！

[来自[url=https://portdev.itch.io/aajd]itch.io[/url]]
